description: Custom React hook that detects if the user prefers a dark color scheme using the CSS media query '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'. It manages state and subscribes to changes in the media query to update the preference dynamically.

methods.name: usePrefersColorScheme()
methods.description: A React hook that returns a boolean indicating if the user prefers a dark color scheme. It sets up event listeners to respond to changes in the media query.
